# Lumari

> Lumari (YC X25) is the first AI supply chain platform for direct procurement. Autonomous agents handle RFQ workflows, extract and normalize quote data from emails and PDFs, manage purchase order lifecycles, and coordinate supplier follow-ups — so procurement teams stop copy-pasting and chasing status.

Lumari replaces manual, email-based procurement with AI agents that work inside a team's existing email workflow. User-agent: *
Disallow: /sandbox
Disallow: /api
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /settings/my-account

# Specifically allow access to OG Image api, otherwise eg Twitter won't render these images.
Allow: /api/social/og/image
# Specifically allow access to api/app-store to allow search engines to fetch assets
Allow: /api/app-store/

# No AI training, allow search, and allow AI input.
Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes

# The index lists every localized sitemap, so a new locale needs no change here.
Sitemap: https://cal.com/sitemap.xml
# Discover's city pages are generated by the app, so they have their own sitemap.
Sitemap: https://cal.com/discover/sitemap.xml
